The Backrooms is a series that is all about an endless yellow maze full of monsters and mysteries, and those mysteries will be solved in today’s video. With the movie releasing soon, I wanted to take another look back at this series and compile this resource for anyone who is curious about the film, wants to learn more and who may need a refresher on this complicated story, all in one place. Here it is the COMPLETE timeline of the Backrooms!
